metadata.title: Influence of a stellar cusp on the dynamics of young stellar discs and the origin of the S-stars in the Galactic Centre

notes: No eligible stars. The paper discusses S-stars and hyper-velocity stars only as populations or as outcomes of simulated disc-star evolution (T:p1-b6; T:p9-b1), without identifying any individual Galactic unbound candidate by name or catalogue designation. The “stars” in the simulations and figures are model particles, not identifiable observed stars; S-stars are described as orbiting the central SMBH rather than being Galactic unbound candidates.
